dataset.query: FROM logs-aws.mwaa*, logs-aws.stepfunctions*, logs-aws.emr* | WHERE (aws.mwaa.task_id == "dag_complete") OR (aws.stepfunctions.status IS NOT NULL AND aws.stepfunctions.current_state == "PipelineComplete") OR (aws.emr.state IS NOT NULL AND labels.orchestration_mode == "manual") | STATS `Total runs` = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.pipeline_run_id)

FROM logs-aws.mwaa*, logs-aws.emr*, logs-aws.glue*, logs-aws.stepfunctions* | WHERE labels.pipeline_run_id IS NOT NULL AND event.dataset != "aws.glue_dataquality" | STATS total = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.pipeline_run_id), failures = COUNT_DISTINCT(CASE(event.outcome == "failure", labels.pipeline_run_id, null)) | EVAL `Failure %` = ROUND(failures * 100.0 / total, 1)
FROM logs-aws.mwaa* | WHERE aws.mwaa.task_id == "dag_complete" AND aws.mwaa.duration_ms IS NOT NULL | STATS `Avg duration` = ROUND(AVG(aws.mwaa.duration_ms), 0)

FROM logs-aws.glue_dataquality* | MV_EXPAND aws.glue_dataquality.failed_rule_types | WHERE aws.glue_dataquality.failed_rule_types IN ("ColumnExists", "ColumnCount", "ColumnDataType") OR labels.schema_drift_detected == "true" | STATS `Drift runs` = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.pipeline_run_id)
FROM logs-aws.glue_dataquality* | WHERE aws.glue_dataquality.rules.failed > 0 | STATS `DQ failed runs` = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.pipeline_run_id)

FROM logs-aws.mwaa*, logs-aws.emr*, logs-aws.glue*, logs-aws.glue_dataquality*, logs-aws.stepfunctions*, logs-aws.eventbridge* | WHERE labels.orchestration_mode IS NOT NULL | STATS c = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.pipeline_run_id) BY mode = labels.orchestration_mode

FROM logs-aws.mwaa* | WHERE aws.mwaa.task_id == "dag_complete" | EVAL status = CASE(event.outcome == "failure", "Failed", aws.mwaa.quality_check == "DEGRADED", "Degraded", aws.mwaa.quality_check == "SCHEMA_DRIFT", "Schema Drift", aws.mwaa.quality_check == "DQ_RULES_FAILED", "DQ Rules Failed", "Success") | STATS c = COUNT() BY status
FROM logs-aws.emr* | WHERE error.type IS NOT NULL | STATS c = COUNT() BY err = error.type

FROM logs-aws.mwaa*, logs-aws.emr*, logs-aws.glue*, logs-aws.glue_dataquality*, logs-aws.eks*, logs-aws.s3access*, logs-aws.eventbridge*, logs-aws.stepfunctions* | STATS c = COUNT() BY b = BUCKET(`@timestamp`, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | SORT b

FROM logs-aws.emr* | WHERE aws.emr.duration_ms IS NOT NULL | STATS avg_ms = ROUND(AVG(aws.emr.duration_ms), 0), p95_ms = ROUND(PERCENTILE(aws.emr.duration_ms, 95), 0) BY b = BUCKET(`@timestamp`, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | SORT b

config.title: Data quality score by run (Glue DQ)

dataset.query: FROM logs-aws.glue_dataquality* | WHERE aws.glue_dataquality.score IS NOT NULL | STATS avg_score = ROUND(AVG(aws.glue_dataquality.score), 3), min_score = ROUND(MIN(aws.glue_dataquality.score), 3) BY b = BUCKET(`@timestamp`, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | SORT b

config.title: DQ rules failed by rule type

dataset.query: FROM logs-aws.glue_dataquality* | MV_EXPAND aws.glue_dataquality.failed_rule_types | WHERE aws.glue_dataquality.failed_rule_types IS NOT NULL | STATS c = COUNT() BY b = BUCKET(`@timestamp`, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend), rule_type = aws.glue_dataquality.failed_rule_types | SORT b

config.title: Schema drift rules failed over time (Glue DQ)

dataset.query: FROM logs-aws.glue_dataquality* | MV_EXPAND aws.glue_dataquality.failed_rule_types | WHERE aws.glue_dataquality.failed_rule_types IN ("ColumnExists", "ColumnCount", "ColumnDataType") | STATS c = COUNT() BY b = BUCKET(`@timestamp`, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend), rule_type = aws.glue_dataquality.failed_rule_types | SORT b

config.title: Pipeline runs by DAG and status

dataset.query: FROM logs-aws.mwaa* | WHERE aws.mwaa.task_id == "dag_complete" | STATS runs = COUNT(), failures = SUM(CASE(event.outcome == "failure", 1, 0)), degraded = SUM(CASE(aws.mwaa.quality_check == "DEGRADED", 1, 0)), drift = SUM(CASE(aws.mwaa.quality_check == "SCHEMA_DRIFT", 1, 0)), dq_failed = SUM(CASE(aws.mwaa.quality_check == "DQ_RULES_FAILED", 1, 0)), avg_dq_score = ROUND(AVG(aws.mwaa.dq_score), 3), avg_ms = ROUND(AVG(aws.mwaa.duration_ms), 0) BY dag = aws.mwaa.dag_id | SORT runs DESC | LIMIT 20

config.title: DQ results delivered to S3 (Kafka Connect S3 sink)

dataset.query: FROM logs-aws.s3access* | WHERE aws.s3access.key LIKE "topics/glue.dq.results/*" AND aws.s3access.operation == "REST.PUT.OBJECT" | STATS commit_count = COUNT(), runs_count = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.pipeline_run_id), total_bytes = SUM(aws.s3access.bytes_sent), avg_ms = ROUND(AVG(aws.s3access.total_time), 0), errors_count = SUM(CASE(aws.s3access.http_status >= 400, 1, 0)) BY bucket = aws.s3access.bucket | SORT commit_count DESC | LIMIT 20

FROM logs-aws.mwaa*, logs-aws.emr*, logs-aws.glue*, logs-aws.glue_dataquality*, logs-aws.eventbridge*, logs-aws.stepfunctions* | STATS Events = COUNT() BY Region = cloud.region | SORT Events DESC | LIMIT 15

FROM metrics-aws.emr_metrics* | STATS yarn_mem_avail = ROUND(AVG(`aws.emr.metrics.YARNMemoryAvailablePercentage.avg`), 1), hdfs_util = ROUND(AVG(`aws.emr.metrics.HDFSUtilization.avg`), 1) BY b = BUCKET(`@timestamp`, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | SORT b

config.title: Glue driver JVM heap usage — CloudWatch (metrics)

dataset.query: FROM metrics-aws.glue* | STATS heap_usage = ROUND(AVG(`aws.glue.metrics.glue.driver.jvm.heap.usage.avg`), 3) BY b = BUCKET(`@timestamp`, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | SORT b

config.title: Confluent Kafka on EKS — pod utilization — CloudWatch (metrics)

dataset.query: FROM metrics-aws.kubernetes* | STATS pod_cpu = ROUND(AVG(`aws.kubernetes.metrics.pod_cpu_utilization.avg`), 1), pod_mem = ROUND(AVG(`aws.kubernetes.metrics.pod_memory_utilization.avg`), 1) BY b = BUCKET(`@timestamp`, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | SORT b
